chapter-display.purpose: Primary Songti headlines in travel, singing, and reading.

body.purpose: Introductions, observations, captions, and explanatory evidence.

shadows.name: sports-offset-left

components.name: Back Link
components.description: Shared return control with a restrained directional hover and chapter-colored focus ring.
components.html: 返回兴趣
components.css: .ds-chrome-sample { color: #17382f; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-back-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; color: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-back-link svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-back-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(-3px); } .ds-back-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e6632e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chapter Navigation
components.description: Four numbered chapter links; the active link gains full opacity and a fine underline.
components.html: 01运动02旅行03唱歌04读书
components.css: .ds-chapter-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 36px); color: #17382f; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-chapter-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; opacity: .48; transition: border-color 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease; } .ds-chapter-link span { font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-chapter-link:hover, .ds-chapter-link.ds-is-current { border-color: currentColor; opacity: 1; } .ds-chapter-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e6632e; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-chapter-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 5px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent); } .ds-chapter-link { justify-content: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; } }

components.name: Sports Entry
components.description: Numbered photographic entry that becomes part of the one-screen collage on wide desktop and a paper-offset sequence on mobile.
components.css: .ds-sports-entry { width: 300px; margin: 0; color: #17382f; } .ds-sports-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #dfe5d5; box-shadow: 16px 18px 0 #dfe5d5; } .ds-sports-entry figcaption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 25px; } .ds-sports-entry figcaption > span { padding-top: 6px; color: #e15825; font: 10px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-sports-entry h3 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 400 36px/1 Georgia, 'Noto Serif SC', serif; } .ds-sports-entry p { margin: 0; font: 14px/1.75 Kanit, sans-serif; opacity: .72; } @media (min-width: 1280px) { .ds-sports-photo { box-shadow: none; } } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-sports-entry { width: 88%; } .ds-sports-photo { box-shadow: 9px 11px 0 #dfe5d5; } }

components.name: Travel Note
components.description: Loose archival place note built from a varied-ratio photograph, fine rule, index, place, and observation.
components.css: .ds-travel-note { width: min(620px, 100%); margin: 0; color: #382d25; } .ds-travel-photo { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: #d8c9b5; filter: saturate(.82) contrast(.97); } .ds-travel-note figcaption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(80px, .42fr) 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(56,45,37,.32); } .ds-travel-note figcaption > span { padding-top: 6px; color: #9c4229; font: 10px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-travel-note h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 32px/1.2 'Songti SC', SimSun, serif; } .ds-travel-note p { margin: 2px 0 0; font: 13px/1.8 Kanit, sans-serif; opacity: .74; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-travel-note { width: 91%; } .ds-travel-note figcaption { grid-template-columns: 30px 78px 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-travel-note p { font-size: 12px; } }

components.name: Singing Photo Placeholder
components.description: Neutral warm-burgundy placeholder that preserves a personal-photo slot, ratio, and replacement note.
components.css: .ds-singing-figure { width: min(420px, 100%); margin: 0; color: #eee7df; } .ds-singing-photo { display: flex; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(238,231,223,.16); background: #302628; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-singing-photo span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-singing-photo small { color: #c98b73; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-singing-figure figcaption { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; margin-top: 14px; color: #bfb1a9; font: 11px/1.6 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-singing-figure figcaption span { color: #e2d8d1; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-singing-figure figcaption p { max-width: 210px; margin: 0; text-align: right; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-singing-figure figcaption { display: block; } .ds-singing-figure figcaption p { margin-top: 7px; text-align: left; } }

components.name: Learning Method Row
components.description: Ruled workbench row that exposes sequence, method name, and explanation without a card container.
components.html:
1. 02

    AI 追问

    让 AI 以苏格拉底式提问持续追问依据、边界与反例，暴露理解盲区。
components.css: .ds-method-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,33,36,.3); color: #172124; list-style: none; } .ds-method-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(70px,.2fr) minmax(180px,.55fr) 1fr; gap: 24px; align-items: baseline; padding: 28px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,33,36,.22); } .ds-method-list li > span { color: #147168; font: 11px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-method-list h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 32px/1.2 'Songti SC', SimSun, serif; } .ds-method-list p { max-width: 650px; margin: 0; font: 14px/1.8 Kanit, sans-serif; opacity: .75; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-method-list li { grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 10px 12px; padding: 24px 0; } .ds-method-list p { grid-column: 2; } }

components.name: Reading Proof Figure
components.description: Neutral evidence frame with explicit output label, replacement ratio, and provenance note.
components.css: .ds-proof-figure { width: min(620px, 100%); margin: 0; color: #172124; } .ds-proof-photo { display: flex; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; align-items: flex-end; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(23,33,36,.18); background: #d9dad3; } .ds-proof-photo span { color: #147168; font: 700 11px/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-proof-figure figcaption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 5px 20px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,33,36,.25); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-proof-figure figcaption strong { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-proof-figure figcaption span { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; opacity: .55; } .ds-proof-figure figcaption p { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; opacity: .65; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-proof-figure { width: 92%; } }

narrative.overview:
The experience is a restrained, high-end personal archive. A quiet return link, numbered chapter navigation, disciplined footer, generous page edges, and serif-led editorial typography make every route feel like part of one collected volume. Photography and whitespace carry more meaning than interface chrome.

Inside that frame, each interest keeps a distinct language: sports is bright and breathing, travel is warm and loosely sequenced, singing is a deep burgundy rehearsal book, and reading is a precise research workbench. These are coordinated chapters, not a repeated page template with cosmetic color swaps. Motion is light, focus is exact, and smaller screens recompose the editorial order instead of miniaturizing desktop arrangements.
keyCharacteristics: Shared return, chapter navigation, image-ratio, and footer grammar.
Four chapter-specific paper, ink, accent, typography, and composition systems.
Photography, evidence, and whitespace before interface decoration.
Editorial sequences instead of card walls.
Quiet interaction with explicit focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Mobile compositions that reorganize rather than shrink.

rules.name: The One Accent per Chapter Rule
rules.body: Use the active chapter accent for labels, indices, focus, and tiny signals; do not introduce a second competing accent.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Canvas Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds should read as paper or a rehearsal-room field, never as glass, neon space, or a gradient spectacle.

rules.name: The Serif Leads, Sans Indexes Rule
rules.body: Use serif type for voice and meaning; use sans-serif type for navigation, numbering, metadata, and explanatory evidence.

rules.name: The Deliberate Break Rule
rules.body: Preserve authored headline breaks on large compositions, then choose new readable breaks for mobile rather than scaling the same line shape down.

rules.name: The Recompose, Never Shrink Rule
rules.body: At mobile width, change reading order, widths, alignment, and line breaks; never compress a desktop collage until it merely fits.

rules.name: The Whitespace Is Content Rule
rules.body: Large gaps establish pacing and chapter boundaries. Do not fill them with ornamental modules or extra copy.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient card shadows. A shadow is allowed only as the established sports photo-offset device.

rules.name: The Ratio Carries Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Vary photo proportions and placement to pace a chapter; do not normalize every image into the same card silhouette.

dos: Do preserve the shared return, four-chapter index, footer, and chapter-aware focus color on every interest route.
Do let real photographs, replacement-ready proof frames, and whitespace dominate the visual hierarchy.
Do keep sports as a one-screen collage at 1280px and above and a staggered sequence on mobile.
Do keep reading process evidence separate from finished article output.
Do preserve visible focus states and collapse animation and transitions under reduced-motion preferences.
Do recompose complex layouts at 760px and below so text and evidence retain their intended order.
donts: Don't turn the archive into a repeated card grid or generic portfolio template.
Don't add glass panels, neon accents, complex gradients, ambient card shadows, or effect-heavy motion.
Don't force the four chapters into one interchangeable composition or palette.
Don't invent achievements, article titles, or screenshots where the implementation intentionally shows replacement-ready evidence placeholders.
Don't round every image, wrap text in decorative containers, or fill deliberate whitespace.
Don't shrink desktop collages into miniature mobile layouts.
